text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Bamboo Memory...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah! Please take a look, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Bamboo Memory pointed,
there was a claw machine filled with plushies
themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Seeing all those rivals lined up side by side gets my blood pumping just looking at them!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I have this plushie in my room, I can get fired up anytime!
I'm gonna challenge it right away!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh, the claw won't stop where
I'm aiming... This is surprisingly har—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaaah!!
Why'd ya drop it halfway through, seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Female Clerk
text_block_list.text: E-Excuse me, customer! Please refrain from shaking the arcade cabinet!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I got way too heated up.
Can't cause any more trouble for folks...
choice_data_list: I'll give it a try next.
I'll give it a try next.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! You're gonna take on the challenge too, Trainer-san?!
Then I'll cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hooray, hooray! Trainer!
Let's go, let's go! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
